_comment: Rescreen policy. Scoring parameters are NOT duplicated here: they are the milestone-1 frozen config (config/frozen_config.json), pinned by its config_sha256 below. Freeze with: python -m rescreen freeze-policy
alert_rule: Raise or keep an alert for a customer/list-entry pair that blocking retrieved when the name-only OR Splink decision is LINK or REVIEW, or when the guard routes it to REVIEW.

approval_basis_types.verified_identifier_conflict: Customer's verified identifier differs from the listed identifier (cited evidence IDs must still be current and still differ).
approval_basis_types.verified_full_dob_conflict: Customer's verified full DOB differs from the listed full DOB (cited evidence IDs must still be current and still differ).

qa_hold_policy: A proposed setting that turns any labelled true link into a miss (no LINK and no REVIEW) is HELD for review.
